headline: The Pokémon Company says it will open a permanent Pokémon store in London by 2029.
body: It will be the brand's first permanent physical shop outside Asia and the first of several planned outside the region. No site has been announced; London has so far had only temporary Pokémon Center pop-ups.
why: A Japanese content owner is choosing London as its first permanent retail base outside Asia, a sign of how the UK fan market (lesson 15) is now valued directly by rights holders rather than only through licensees and events.
